Frequently asked questions

Keep only five concise, high-intent questions.

What are the main advantages of AAC blocks?

Lower wall load, useful thermal resistance, controlled dimensions and efficient installation.

What are the disadvantages of AAC blocks?

Careful handling, correct anchors, moisture detailing and trained workmanship are important.

Are AAC blocks better than red bricks?

It depends on the complete installed wall, local supply, design and workmanship.

Does AAC automatically reduce structural cost?

No. Structural savings require project-specific redesign around the lower wall load.

Why is autoclaving important?

It develops the hardened mineral structure responsible for AAC’s final properties.
